status: Prospective development sensitivity protocol, written before any new cost-stress replay or outputs. No policy, menu or fee-rate winner is selected.
question: Q3 known-cost sensitivity of the frozen annual-then-pending comparator and the separately specified pathwise hold shield; distinguish target freezing from recalibration.

data.scope: Reused development only. Original combined CSV may be hashed for provenance, but final returns121--180 are never parsed.

frozen_design.products: All strict172 six-context frozen targets, local172/global232 mapping and effective assignments; no optimization/refit/gamma/reassignment/admission update at any cost. Existing A/D Review outcomes remain null.
frozen_design.contexts: One full120 descriptive context, five original96-training/24-test outer contexts; retain all120 original client/path rows per policy in each full/OOF view.
frozen_design.history: Each client original H begins100/all bills/CPI1/peak100/MDD0. Original H/L and annual observation convention remain fixed; no peak, everbreach or horizon reset.
frozen_design.accounting: Exact self-financing fee C=c*actual_moved counted once, including mandatory initial allocation; no terminal fee. Pending holds actual asset quantities after the first annual endpoint MDD-L>1e-12, starting at the following decision, without adviser response/re-entry.

known_cost_forecast.consistency: At each rate, both actual fee accounting and every current/future forecast baseline fee use that SAME known rate. This does not study cost misestimation.
known_cost_forecast.fan: Freeze all full120 or outer96 complete joint training paths and their same calendar t:H suffixes. No held-out current or future return enters the gate.
known_cost_forecast.pathwise_gate: Hold iff every forecast path has computed total_log_hold>=total_log_restore AND everbreach_hold<=everbreach_restore. Growth allowance EXACT0; no epsilon debt, eta, probability margin or rate tuning. Initial mandatory restore and actual postbreach pending hold remain unchanged.

training_support_check.per_rate: For every served client/context/rate replay BOTH policies on every same training fan path, verify terminal total log growth >= comparator up to the separately declared numerical audit guard and absorbing everbreach <= comparator. Record any strict computed negative growth values and all event-order violations. Failure aborts rather than being hidden.
training_support_check.interpretation: Full120 plus5 overlapping96 training contexts give600 context-labeled path identities per client, not600 independent scenarios. The ideal fixed-support induction is not an OOF/population guarantee or an MDD-severity ordering.

base_reproduction.required: Reproduce every saved v2 assigned per-path financial metric, actual fees/transfers/trade fraction, breach/first crossing and all available actual/training trace fields. Review null masks/identities/denominators must match. Also recompute base summary/paired and training-support receipts against the frozen v2 artifacts.
base_reproduction.comparison: Numeric saved CSV/trace checks use atol2e-10,rtol5e-13 for serialization roundoff; bool/integer/action identities exact. This is a verification tolerance, never a gate allowance.

outputs.client_paths: All cost/context/client/scenario/policy rows, financial fields null for Review. Same real annualized-log-growth/CAGR/MDD/volatility and nominal fee/transfer/trade conventions as frozen v2.
outputs.summary_and_paired: At each rate separately, pooled individual full/OOF path summaries and paired rule-minus-comparator deltas; inverted-CDF P10/P90, standard median, fractional-atom CVaR90. Do not average fold quantiles.
outputs.decision_changes: Pair each rate with base. For every assigned path record the proportion of all original-H decisions with a changed hold/restore action, actual-trade flag or pending flag; additionally describe action changes among decisions active in BOTH rates after inception. These compare whole trajectories with different wealth/state/crossing history, not a controlled marginal cost effect at the same state. Review has no decision outcome.
outputs.training: Context-labeled per-rate support path checks and summaries, preserving Review null rows and overlap labels.
outputs.traces_and_provenance: Actual and training core traces in NPZ with cost_label prefix, declared Q/gate records, original source/input start=end hashes, output hashes, development-array digest and scenario list. No final data loaded.

acceptance: Prospective protocol and implementation/test source hashes are frozen before first cost-stress market replay.
Old source hashes, strict products/assignments/folds and base artifact hashes match before and after.
Guarded development identities are exactly1..120, no duplicates or final paths.
Each rate preserves2400 full/OOF client-policy rows and3000 context-labeled training client-path rows; all Review financial/Q outcomes remain null.
Base rate reproduces v2 saved artifacts; all rates satisfy declared training-support comparisons or abort.
Independent audit can replay actual fees/state/breach and a fixed declared Q subset without using numerical kernels.
independent_audit_subset: For each cost/served context/client use smallest evaluation scenario ID and returnyears2,floor(H/2)+1,H, deduplicate; audit active Q states only and report pending skips without replacement. Scalar independent bisection should reconstruct both action fan arrays, violations, chosen action, local deletion count and all actual cash flows.
limits: These rates are declared hypothetical sensitivities, not empirical cost estimates.
Frozen menu stability is imposed by design and is not evidence that recalibrated targets would remain unchanged.
No fee rate/policy winner is selected, no new risk certification, no true-distribution or OOF guarantee from training-support dominance.
Changing known costs can change the actual path, crossing time and gates. It does not erase any realized event or simulate human intervention.
